document_title: 12 of 120. The UT System's health AI pilots
_note: Slide strings read off the render report's text nodes and each frame's own source line by build_copy.py.
caption:
At UTHealth Houston, a no-show project's entry states what it saved.

The UT System's page credits it with saving more than 6,500 appointments and $900,000 in revenue. The page cites no audit behind it. The page projects at least 15,000 a year at UT Health San Antonio, where it is set to expand.

The project is one of 12 pilots UT REAL Health AI funded out of 120 systemwide submissions. A UT San Antonio pilot puts an AI assistant called Leah into emergency triage at seven UT hospital sites. UTMB Galveston is deploying referral triage. A Dell Medical School pilot will read clinical notes across more than 7 million patient records for signs of suicide risk.

Of the 12 entries, only the no-show entry states what it already saved.

UT REAL Health AI holds its symposium in Austin on October 7th and 8th. Will a second pilot bring a count of its own?

#UTHealthHouston #UTREALHealthAI #UTSystem

S1.headline: 12 of 120.
S1.body: The UT System's health care AI laboratory funded 12 pilot projects out of 120 submissions. The awards total more than $3.6 million. Each gold window stands for one funded pilot.
strings: The UT System's health care AI laboratory funded 12 pilot projects out of 120 submissions. The awards total more than $3.6 million. Each gold window stands for one funded pilot.

S2.headline: One AI assistant, seven UT hospital sites
S2.body: At UT San Antonio, a pilot deploys an assistant called Leah for emergency triage and transfer decisions. The page says it was trained on more than 400,000 trauma cases.
strings: One AI assistant, seven UT hospital sites

S3.headline: Six tools inside Epic
S3.body: At UT Dell Medical School a pilot implements six AI tools built into Epic. They automate lab result messaging and generate imaging summaries for patients.
strings: At UT Dell Medical School a pilot implements six AI tools built into Epic. They automate lab result messaging and generate imaging summaries for patients.

S4.headline: It will read the notes.
S4.body: A Dell Medical School pilot will use large language models across more than 7 million patient records. It will look for signs of suicide risk.
strings: A Dell Medical School pilot will use large language models across more than 7 million patient records. It will look for signs of suicide risk.

S5.headline: One entry states what it saved.
S5.body: The page credits the no-show project with more than 6,500 appointments saved at UTHealth Houston and cites no audit behind it. It projects at least 15,000 a year at UT Health San Antonio.
labels: HOUSTON, AS THE PAGE STATES IT

S6.headline: Eleven entries, no saved count.
S6.body: Only the no-show entry states what it already saved, and the page cites no audit behind it. The other eleven describe the work, not what it saved.
strings: Only the no-show entry states what it already saved, and the page cites no audit behind it. The other eleven describe the work, not what it saved.

S7.headline: UTMB is deploying referral triage.
S7.body: In Galveston the tool reads the health record, assigns an urgency score and routes patients to a level of care.
strings: In Galveston the tool reads the health record, assigns an urgency score and routes patients to a level of care.

S8.headline: Two more expand earlier platforms.
S8.body: A trial prescreening platform was validated on nearly 40,000 patients at UT Southwestern. An AI grading platform for medical school simulation exams has run for more than three years.
strings: A trial prescreening platform was validated on nearly 40,000 patients at UT Southwestern. An AI grading platform for medical school simulation exams has run for more than three years.

S9.headline: Austin, October 7th and 8th
S9.body: UT REAL Health AI holds its symposium there. Its page carries a link to register.
